releases.title: Hosted stability and visible version history
changes: Fixed Anthropic model calls that reject the deprecated temperature parameter.
Added a shared project version source for the web app and Python package.
Added release metadata so Studio and GitHub can show version history.

releases.title: Hosted ComicLearn Studio
changes: Launched the hosted Studio flow for public users through Vercel and Railway.
Kept provider API keys on the backend while users access the product through the web UI.
Added invite-only signup, usage caps, persistent Railway storage, and provider configuration checks.
Updated the generation stack for Claude text, Gemini image generation, Mathpix OCR, and story/art QA.
